author: Piemels
body:
hey, im i_REK_everyone and i've played on the avic.us network.
Today i got banned because people were thinking i was hacking with Anti-Knockback.
That is not true, I was lagging very hard because my internet is very bad.
I dont know if there is any evidence of me hacking so....
Please read and think about it.
If i was a hacker, i probably wouldnt mind get banned because if i would hack i would know the consequenses.
I like playing on the avic.us network very much so please uban me!...

Greetings,

i_REK_everyone`

ps: i see that the person that banned me (jozzmcozz) is permbanned, then how is he able to permban me?

Regards,
Pelpelajax Avicus Network Senior Moderator.

replies.body: other people were thinking I was hacking with Kill aura too, but to convince them that I wasn't hacking I said: .legit, saying .legit while playing with a hacked client is not possible (I think) because I heard from people that hacked clients pick up messages with a . as a command. Just please beleave me, if i was hacking i would have known the consequenses and i probably wouldnt have cared. :(
